# Mobile UX Verification

## Release

- Commit: `2fcf49b3cc2d47ae6bcd30ad5acd66da07424ecf`.
- Parent: `3e544cc749ead3093279660cb253c61bd1643f10`.
- Push: normal fast-forward to `origin/main`; no force push.
- Canonical deployment emitted both `CANONICAL_SERVER_ACTIVE` and `CANONICAL_DEPLOY_OK` for the mobile UX SHA.

## Screenshot defect repaired

The previous design placed Generate in a fixed overlay while Estimated Cost lived in normal page flow. Phone scroll positions could therefore place the action directly over cost/readiness copy.

The release replaces that relationship with one normal-flow submission panel containing Estimated Cost, Price Details, readiness copy, and Generate. The panel also has bottom-nav scroll clearance using the configured navigation height plus safe-area inset.

## Added creation guidance

- Prominent `Paste prompt` action.
- Four one-tap prompt starters: Cinematic shot, Product reveal, Character moment, and World building.
- Template application preserves the existing textarea node, focus, and live readiness state.
- Text mode now uses a compact instructional reference section instead of a large empty media tray.
- Frame mode explains first-frame, last-frame, and coherence guidance.
- Reference mode explains image, video, and audio roles plus a character-consistency tip.
- Media add controls remain available only in modes where they are meaningful.

## Defects found during verification

1. Compact text mode initially exposed an old binder assumption that a hidden file input always existed. `CreateAssetEvents` was rewritten to bind optional controls only when rendered.
2. Cost and Generate no longer overlapped, but the full submission panel could still scroll under the fixed bottom nav. Explicit scroll margin was added for nav height + safe area.
3. Initial guidance CSS exceeded the 120-line rule and was split into prompt guidance and reference guidance stylesheets instead of compressed.

## Automated evidence

- Every Olam file: <=120 lines.
- JavaScript syntax: pass.
- Generate fixed-position check: pass; Generate is not fixed.
- Node suite: 19 passed, 0 failed.

## Local browser geometry evidence

At 360x800 the deterministic browser test proved:

- cinematic template fills the prompt
- textarea identity and focus are preserved
- reference guide visibly contains Images, Video, Audio, and character-consistency guidance
- Estimated Cost bottom is above Generate top
- submission panel bottom is above bottom-nav top after scroll
- no horizontal overflow
- 768px and 1440px widths also have no horizontal overflow
- no captured console or failed-network errors

## Production browser evidence

After canonical deployment, a fresh Chrome profile against `https://awtsmoos.com` printed:

`PASS browser smoke: templates, references guide, no submission overlap, provider gate, responsive`

followed by:

`PUBLIC_MOBILE_UX_BROWSER_PASS`

The public test also fetched the new `CreatePromptTemplates.js` asset successfully before running.

## External boundary

The separate MiniMax production credential remains absent. That does not affect this UI repair; the provider-ready guard continues to truthfully prevent paid submission until `MINIMAX_API_KEY` exists.
